_provenance.local_operation: deterministic SigGen via PKCS#11: C_CreateObject(CKO_PRIVATE_KEY, CKK_ML_DSA, CKA_VALUE = upstream sk) then C_SignInit with CK_SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT hedgeVariant = CKH_DETERMINISTIC_REQUIRED + upstream context, C_Sign; output byte-compared to the upstream signature
_provenance.transformation: subset only; every retained field is byte-copied from the upstream file; same upstream file (and sha256) as mldsa_test.json
_provenance.subset_policy: Deterministic. One case per deterministic group that PKCS#11 can express (external/pure, external/preHash, internal/externalMu=true) for each parameter set: the shortest message (mu is always 64 bytes), ties broken by lowest tcId; for preHash groups only hashAlg values with a PKCS#11 v3.2 CKM_HASH_ML_DSA_<hash> mechanism are eligible. Hedged groups (deterministic=false) and internal/externalMu=false groups are listed in notExecuted as metadata only.
_provenance.retained_fields: tcId, hashAlg, sk, message|mu, context, signature (pk and deferred dropped)
_provenance.test_only_key_material: sk values are public NIST ACVP-Server sample data, imported into a session (CKA_TOKEN=false) object and destroyed after the case; they are not secrets
